response.text:
I still need one clear thing before I can send: **who is the QAR 300 going to?**

Your message said "Ama lai QAR 300 pathau" (send QAR 300 to Ama), but you're now talking about securing a room. Those are two different recipients:

1. **Ama** — your mother in Nepal (NPR)
2. **Al Noor Rooms** — your landlord in Qatar (QAR)

Please reply with just the recipient name and I'll send it right away. I can't send until you confirm, since sending to the wrong person can't be undone.
